ideas.title: One-command installer with per-assistant adapter pack
ideas.disclosure_rationale: OSS methodology kit; no IP concerns

sources.ref: training-data prior on npx create-* / pnpm create / cargo new as the modal OSS Day-1 install gesture 2022-2025
training-data prior on multi-assistant adapter packs shipped per-assistant

ideas.validation_plan: Count public-GitHub clones with .sad/ directories appearing in code-search 90 days post-release. Predicted >=5x baseline.
risks: maintenance burden disproportionate to v0.1 OSS
adapter packs drift from canonical commands/ and hooks/
telemetry opt-in too noisy for reliable signal
ideas.adversarial_review: Counter: 'installer for a methodology is overkill'. Holds partially; counter-counter: per-assistant adapter pack is the genuine work, not the file copy.
ideas.pre_mortem: Adapter packs go out of sync with source SAD repo; installer writes stale .claude/settings.json files.
next_steps: Publish as @sad/init (npm) and sad-init (PyPI) once adapter shape is stable

ideas.title: Level-0 Solo-SAD maturity entry + opt-in AI-stand-in reviewers

sources.ref: arXiv 2508.06484 (Virk & Liu) — also cited in SAD's own .sad/stakeholders/non-technical.md

ideas.validation_plan: Track share of public-GitHub clones with 'Maturity level (initial): Level 0' line in constitution. Predicted >=20% within 90 days.
risks: AI stand-in reproduces human's blind spots
ideas.adversarial_review: Counter: 'AI-stand-in is the spec-theatre failure mode itself'. Holds in part; counter-counter: artifact discipline (the larger Virk & Liu protection) survives; AI is adversarial reviewer not approver; calibration ritual forces periodic human re-check.
ideas.pre_mortem: Solo adopters skip the calibration ritual; AI stand-in degenerates into approval theater.
next_steps: Add Level 0 row to MATURITY.md + sentence to SAD_USER_GUIDE.md §7.1
Add calibration line to constitution template under Identity

ideas.title: Cross-platform helper scripts via Node/Python single runtime
ideas.validation_plan: CI matrix (ubuntu-latest + macos-latest + windows-latest). Predicted: 100% green on Windows post-port (today: 0%).
risks: Path B (single runtime) adds Node/Python dependency
ideas.adversarial_review: Counter: 'PowerShell sibling scripts cheaper than runtime rewrite'. Holds in part — that is Path A. Path B is strategic option.
ideas.pre_mortem: Path B chosen but Node/Python dependency makes npx-style usage awkward and adopters revert to manual copies.
next_steps: Path A first: hand-port .sh scripts to .ps1 siblings + CI matrix on Windows
Path B as follow-up: rewrite as Node functions exposed via bin/sad-* entry points

ideas.title: QUICKSTART.md + CHEATSHEET.md pair (progressive disclosure)
ideas.validation_plan: A/B test README link (SAD_USER_GUIDE vs QUICKSTART). Measure clones-that-complete-a-feature within 90 days. Predicted >=2x completion from QUICKSTART vs guide-first.
risks: two new docs increase 'yet another file' problem
QUICKSTART truncates so much that adopters think SAD = truncated form
ideas.adversarial_review: Counter: 'user guide §17 already has a cheatsheet'. Holds weakly — §17 lives at line ~1200 of 1357; it's a reward not an entry point.
ideas.pre_mortem: QUICKSTART truncated /sad-impact-forecast; adopters never discovered the predictive forecasting NOVEL.md §3 calls out as a contribution.
next_steps: Promote SAD_USER_GUIDE.md §17 to top-level CHEATSHEET.md, trim to <=80 lines, add mermaid lifecycle
Update README.md 'Where to start' to show QUICKSTART above the user guide

ideas.title: Domain-specific constitution starter pack
standards_impact: regulated.md starter references change-control framings normatively, does not impose

sources.ref: OSS starter-template patterns (.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE, licensee, Cursor starter rules)

ideas.validation_plan: Count constitution.md files in clones retaining >=3 articles from a published starter (text-match via <!-- starter:web-app v1 --> marker). Predicted >=30% within 90 days.
risks: maintenance burden grows with each new starter
ideas.adversarial_review: Counter: 'starter packs discourage thinking; make every SAD constitution look the same'. Holds weakly — each starter has a pre-named tension the adopter must resolve.
ideas.pre_mortem: Starters too generic; adopters ignore or copy verbatim without engaging with tensions.
next_steps: Ship web-app.md and library.md first (highest-volume shapes)

ideas.title: /sad-doctor project-wide health-check command

sources.ref: brew doctor / flutter doctor / npm doctor pattern

ideas.validation_plan: Green/yellow/red histogram across opt-in telemetry pings. Predicted: median adopter starts at yellow+3reds, reaches green+1yellow within 30 days.
risks: false-positive reds train users to ignore the command
command becomes a substitute for actually running the lifecycle
ideas.adversarial_review: Counter: 'doctor commands are runtime tools; SAD is artifact-driven'. Holds weakly — doctor reads artifacts and reports; does not modify or gate.
ideas.pre_mortem: Check thresholds calibrated against maintainers' repos rather than real adopters'; too many false-positive yellows.
next_steps: Add commands/sad-doctor.md prompt that invokes it
Wire as non-blocking SessionStart hook in Claude Code adapter pack (I-001)
